write.tools/report.sh:
#!/bin/bash
if [ ! -f "$1" ]; then
  echo "report: $1 not found"
  exit 2
fi
echo "$1: $(wc -l < "$1") lines, $(grep -c ERROR "$1") errors"

hints.tr: `mkdir -p` iki klasörü birden açabilir. `mv inbox/*.log hedef/` bütün .log dosyalarını taşır.
hints.en: `mkdir -p` can create both folders at once. `mv inbox/*.log target/` moves every .log file.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
mkdir -p sorted/logs sorted/data
mv inbox/*.log sorted/logs/
mv inbox/*.csv sorted/data/
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
mkdir -p sorted/logs sorted/data
mv inbox/*.log sorted/logs/
mv inbox/*.csv sorted/data/
```

label.en: The files are in their new places
